name: Anthropic Model Hardware Standard Research Preview — Hardware-Splicer

fields.proposed_contribution: Use Hardware-Splicer as an independent safety-evaluation and release-assurance wrapper around MHS on one revision-bound SPI flash adapter, testing whether device discovery/control remains subordinate to physical evidence, stale-evidence invalidation and explicit human authority.

packet_requirements.description: Prepared MHS capability/contribution note with integration, adversarial safety evaluation, recovery analysis and reusable-output work packages.

Concrete device surface is defined as Hardware-Splicer's spi_flash_adapter_v1. The physical subject does not yet exist; route activation waits for #105 to bind a real board/revision before any MHS command is permitted.

Public MHS material invites stakeholders across science and industry but does not explicitly establish individual-student eligibility. Enter truthfully as an individual university researcher unless the live application requires an institutional/lab wrapper; use YZU faculty/lab affiliation only with actual confirmation.
Prepared bounded evaluation plan for discovery/control, authority refusal, stale-evidence invalidation and failure recovery on the SPI physical-proof subject.

compliance_checks: Do not claim Hardware-Splicer implements MHS before preview integration exists.
Do not represent the applicant as a manufacturing lab or institutional stakeholder unless that is actually true.
Do not fire a software-only interest pitch without a concrete programmable hardware surface.
Keep pending live-model and physical evidence pending.
Do not enable program, erase, status-write or reset operations in the initial MHS evaluation surface.
MHS transport or device discovery never grants fabrication, power-on, functional-test or release authority.
Do not claim a physical MHS evaluation until #105 establishes a real board identity and the required authority gate.

route_evidence.public_scope: limited research preview; stakeholders across science and industry; devices require a programmable interface; safety evaluations are an explicit preview objective

device_plan.subject: hardware-splicer spi_flash_adapter_v1
device_plan.interface: Host SPI -> TXU0304 level shifter -> W25Q128JW
device_plan.mhs_role: device discovery and command transport only; Hardware-Splicer remains the evidence/authority boundary
device_plan.activation_gate: Only after #105 binds a real board identity and reaches the explicit functional-test authority boundary.
